text: Letter from Gilles Marchildon, French Language Advisory Committee member, forwarding an article from Le Métropolitain Toronto advising that Céline Marcoux-Hamade, a Toronto Public Library employee, recently received the "Ordre des Palmes académiques françaises."

The French Language Advisory Committee: 1. Requested that the Chair of the French Language Advisory Committee express the French Language Advisory Committee's congratulations to Céline Marcoux-Hamade, a Toronto Public Library employee, for receiving the "Ordre des Palmes académiques françaises."
